artBrief: **Dark fantasy.** An absurdly small armored traveler emerges from a moss-covered doorway holding a warm lantern. Gentle humor and the glow of a second beginning.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Dark fantasy. An absurdly small armored traveler emerges from a moss-covered doorway holding a warm lantern. Gentle humor and the glow of a second beginning. Tiny friendly armored traveler under a huge moss-covered doorway, one bright amber lantern at chest height. Strong humorous size contrast, deep slate-violet and moss green, hopeful return.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
